From sparkling Christmas trees and falling snow to festive shopping, family photos, and a few unexpected adventures, Disney Springs is full of holiday magic waiting to be discovered!

There's something about Disney Springs at Christmastime that makes you want to wander a little longer and see what's waiting around the next corner.

Last Christmas, Troy and I spent time exploring Disney Springs and doing some Christmas shopping, and we loved it! Between the decorations, the festive atmosphere, and all those little discoveries along the way, it felt like a Christmas outing all its own.

And that's something I think families sometimes overlook when planning their Walt Disney World vacation.

You don't have to be heading into a theme park to experience Disney Christmas magic!

For the 2026 holiday season, Disney Springs is bringing back favorite traditions, introducing new holiday surprises, and offering plenty of opportunities to shop, dine, play, and make memories together.

So grab your Christmas spirit (and maybe leave a little room in those shopping bags), because there's a lot to explore!

Follow the Magic Through the Christmas Tree Stroll 🎄

Twenty Christmas trees, a little Disney magic, and a holiday scavenger hunt!

The Disney Springs Christmas Tree Stroll returns November 11, 2026, through January 3, 2027, with beautifully decorated trees inspired by favorite Disney stories and characters.

And this year, there are some new faces joining the festivities! Look for trees inspired by Bluey, Monsters, Inc., and Hallmark alongside returning favorites like Frozen, Encanto, and The Princess and the Frog.

Want to turn your Christmas tree hunt into a little family adventure?

Pick up a complimentary Christmas Tree Stroll map at participating locations, including The LEGO Store, and match the stickers to the trees you discover. Complete your map and return it for a special holiday surprise!

Between the imaginative decorations, familiar characters, and a few unexpected discoveries, it's a wonderfully festive way to explore Disney Springs together. 🎄✨

A Little Christmas Shopping Magic 🎁

There's Christmas shopping… and then there's Christmas shopping at Disney Springs!

Step inside World of Disney, where festive merchandise, Disney Christmas collections, and gifts for everyone on your list make it awfully easy to forget who you were shopping for in the first place! 😂

And if you love collecting Christmas ornaments, Disney's Days of Christmas is practically calling your name. From Mickey and Minnie to personalized ornaments and holiday decorations, you might just find a new family keepsake for your tree.

Wander into Marketplace Co-Op for unique Disney-inspired gifts, accessories, and home décor, then stop by the new Hallmark Holiday Pop-Up Shop for even more Christmas cheer and those beloved Keepsake Ornaments.

Between the decorated storefronts, festive displays, and all those tempting little discoveries, Christmas shopping here feels like part of the celebration!

And a little bonus for Annual Passholders and Disney Cast Members: Don't forget to ask about eligible shopping and dining discounts. Those holiday purchases can add up, and so can the savings! 🎄💕

A Christmas Celebration at Jock Lindsey's Hangar Bar

Calling all adventurers! 🎄✈️

Jock Lindsey is decking the halls and inviting his fellow world travelers to a Christmas celebration unlike any other!

Step inside the legendary pilot's waterfront hangar, where treasures from faraway adventures mingle with twinkling lights, vintage ornaments, overflowing garlands, and a wonderfully over-the-top collection of Christmas decorations.

There's holiday magic tucked into practically every corner, with plenty of quirky details to discover along the way.

And what's a Christmas party without something delicious? Settle in for a festive bite or seasonal drink while you soak up the cheerful chaos.

It's a little Indiana Jones adventure wrapped up in Christmas magic, right in the heart of Disney Springs! 🎄

A Visit With Santa and a Little Christmas Wish 🎅🎄

Someone very special has made his way from the North Pole to Disney Springs!

Santa Claus is welcoming families to his festive Marketplace from November 11 through Christmas Eve, ready to hear all about those Christmas wishes!

Imagine the excitement as little ones finally get their turn to tell Santa what's on their wish list, share a Christmas secret, or pose for that special holiday picture. ❤️

And the Christmas wishes don't have to stop there! Visit Once Upon a Toy, where children can send their wish lists straight to the North Pole.

A little Santa planning magic: Santa's visit is complimentary, and his Marketplace even includes fresh milk and cookies! 🍪 To meet him, you'll need to join the virtual queue through the My Disney Experience app while you're physically at Disney Springs. Queue opportunities begin at 9 AM, 11 AM, 1 PM, 3 PM, and 5 PM, subject to availability. There's no standby line, so be sure to check the app when you arrive!

Picture-Perfect Christmas Memories at Disney Springs 📸🎄

Gather the family, straighten those Christmas sweaters, and get ready to say cheese! It's time for a little holiday photo magic!

Step inside Disney's PhotoPass Studio, where festive holiday backdrops set the scene for a family Christmas photo shoot. Whether you're gathering everyone together for this year's Christmas card, capturing a sweet moment with the kids, or finally getting a picture with the whole family in it, this is a fun way to make a memory you'll treasure long after the decorations come down.

And here's a little holiday bonus! There's no sitting fee or reservation required. Photos are available for purchase, and eligible Memory Maker or Annual Passholder photo benefits may already include your downloads.

Don't forget to keep your camera handy as you explore Disney Springs! Between the sparkling Christmas trees, glowing lights, and beautifully decorated storefronts, you'll discover plenty of festive spots for a few more family photos along the way.

Who knows? Your favorite Christmas picture this year might be the one you weren't even planning to take! ❤️

A Little Holiday Outfit Inspiration! 🎄❤️

Planning a family Christmas photo during your Disney vacation? This is the perfect excuse to have a little fun coordinating those holiday outfits!

I've put together some festive family outfit inspiration to help you plan your Christmas looks before you pack your bags. And Disney Springs has plenty of beautiful Christmas backdrops to show them off!

A Little Snowfall and a Whole Lot of Christmas Magic! ❄️🎄

Christmas music fills the air, thousands of twinkling lights sparkle overhead, and suddenly, snowflakes are floating through the Florida sky!

Yes, snow in Florida! Well, a little Disney Christmas magic, anyway. ❤️

Head over to Town Center, where Disney Springs brings a touch of winter wonderland to the evening with its magical snowfall. There's something especially fun about watching children reach for those floating flakes while Christmas music plays and the holiday lights glow all around them.

And the entertainment doesn't stop with the snowfall!

Toy Soldier Drummers bring their festive rhythms to the streets, while towering Toy Soldier Stilt Walkers, Peppermint Skaters, and strolling holiday performers add even more Christmas cheer.

You might hear music around one corner, spot a larger-than-life toy soldier around another, or find yourself smiling at a little unexpected holiday fun.

It's the kind of Christmas atmosphere that makes an ordinary evening at Disney Springs feel like a holiday celebration! ✨

A Little Taste of Christmas at Disney Springs! 🍪🎄

Oh, and we can't forget the Christmas treats! 😋

Disney Springs is filled with delicious holiday surprises, from festive desserts and chocolate creations to seasonal drinks that look almost too pretty to eat!

How about a Gingerbread Mickey Cone from Swirls on the Water? Or something beautifully decorated from Amorette's Patisserie? And if chocolate is your weakness, The Ganachery might be calling your name!

Between all the Christmas shopping, twinkling lights, and holiday entertainment, there's always room for a little something sweet. ❤️

And that's just a taste of the holiday goodies waiting around Disney World! I've put together a separate guide to help you discover more festive treats and find them during your vacation.

One little dining tip from me! 💕

If you're thinking about enjoying a nice sit-down dinner while you're at Disney Springs, I'd definitely recommend making a reservation ahead of time, especially during the busy Christmas season! Many of the table-service restaurants are popular, and I'd hate for you to have your heart set on somewhere special only to find there's a long wait or no tables available.

You can make reservations through the My Disney Experience app, typically up to 60 days in advance. And if you're making last-minute plans, it's still worth checking for availability!

A Few New Adventures Along the Way! ✨

And Christmas isn't the only thing bringing something new to Disney Springs this year!

There are some fun new places to discover, whether you're looking for a family activity, a unique souvenir, or something delicious.

Level99 brings interactive challenges and games to Disney Springs, offering a different kind of adventure for teens and adults.

At Kawaii Slime Company, colorful, creative fun takes center stage, with opportunities to create a personalized slime souvenir.

And here's something for the food lovers! Six Ravens, from the creative team behind Gideon's Bakehouse, has introduced its savory stuffed rolls known as Coffyns.

You'll also find newer shopping additions like Vuori, Cole Haan, and Vans, bringing even more variety to the Christmas shopping fun!

A Little Christmas Magic to Take Home ❤️🎄

There's something special about a Christmas outing that leaves you smiling long after you've headed home.

Maybe it's a new ornament that will find its place on your tree every December. A family Christmas picture that becomes this year's holiday card. Or the memory of your children reaching for snowflakes beneath the Florida Christmas lights.

When Troy and I visited Disney Springs last Christmas, we went to enjoy some holiday shopping, but we came away loving the entire Christmas atmosphere. It's one of those experiences I'm excited to share with other families planning their Walt Disney World vacations.

And whether Disney Springs becomes part of your arrival day, a favorite evening during your vacation, or a special Christmas outing all its own, I hope you find a little extra holiday magic waiting there for your family, too.
